Frequently asked questions

A destination is any of the 250+ integrations that Hightouch lets you sync data to. Multiple instances of the same destination will only be counted once. Read our documentation to learn more about what counts as a destination.

Absolutely! Beyond your first free destination, each destination has a 30 day free trial before you are charged for it.

Yes! We fully support in-app self-service billing for our Free, Starter, and Pro plans. We let you manage your plan, explore your usage, and view invoices directly through our UI. Learn more in our self-serve pricing documentation.

We recommend customers to pay annually. Annual billing includes a 20% discount. However, we also support monthly billing for our self-service plans.

Yes. We're happy to help customers regardless of their size. Please message us on Intercom, email us, or book a time with us and we'll make sure set up is effortless as possible.

For early stage startups (<40 employees or <$10M in funding), we offer six months of our Starter plan for free. For business affected by Covid, please reach out to us and we'll be happy to assess on a case by case basis.

For questions related to payments processing, invoices, discounts, overages, or any other billing-related topics, please message us on Intercom or email us, and we will help you resolve the question.
